edges.reason: msg.sender drives whitelist verification, per-address balance accounting and the mint recipient.
msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 entropy for the pseudo-random index.
block.timestamp is used as entropy, making the token assignment miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp flows into the keccak256 randomness construction and modulo.
nextToken performs the keccak256 % maxIndex computation and tokenMatrix modulo indexing.
tokenMatrix is read and written while assigning and swapping random indices.
startFrom is added to the resulting token value.
maxSupply bounds maxIndex and therefore the random range.
availableTokenCount computes maxSupply - totalSupply().
ensureAvailability (availableTokenCount) gates TokenIncrement execution.
totalSupply returns supply.current().
TokenIncrement reads totalSupply() which derives from supply.
TokenIncrement uses totalSupply() to compute the next token id.
nextToken calls TokenIncrement() to advance the counter.
mint calls nextToken() inside its minting loop.
mint safely mints to msg.sender, entering _safeMint and hence the receiver callback path.
mint calls isWhitelisted(msg.sender) to enforce the whitelist gate.
maxMintAmountPerTx bounds _mintAmount in mint.
maxSupply bounds supply.current() + _mintAmount in mint.
paused gates execution of mint.
onlyWhitelisted conditionally enables the whitelist branch in mint.
WLPerAddressLimit bounds ownerMintedCount + _mintAmount.
addressMintedBalance is read and incremented per minted token.
msg.value >= cost * _mintAmount payment arithmetic in mint.
mint increments supply via supply.increment().
isWhitelisted scans the whitelistedAddresses array.
mintForAddress delegates minting to _mintLoop.
_mintLoop calls _safeMint for each token.
_mintLoop calls nextToken() to obtain the random token id.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled contract during minting.
withdraw performs five external payable low-level calls that transfer control to receiving addresses.
withdraw computes percentage shares of address(this).balance before each transfer.
The computed balance share is the value forwarded in the low-level call.
onlyOwner restricts withdraw to the address returned by owner() compared against msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts setPaused to msg.sender == owner().
setPaused writes the paused state variable.
setCost writes the cost state variable.
onlyOwner restricts setCost to msg.sender == owner().
addWhitelistUsers pushes caller-supplied addresses into whitelistedAddresses.
onlyOwner restricts addWhitelistUsers to msg.sender == owner().
_baseURI returns the uriPrefix state variable.
tokenURI branches on the revealed flag.
tokenURI returns hiddenMetadataUri while unrevealed.
tokenURI calls _baseURI() to build the metadata path.
_mintAmount parameter bounds and controls the mint loop.
_mintAmount parameter is forwarded to _mintLoop.
_receiver parameter is the mint recipient.
_user parameter is compared against each whitelisted address.
_owner parameter is used for balanceOf and ownerOf lookups.
_tokenId parameter selects the metadata to return.
_state parameter is written to paused.
_cost parameter is written to cost.
_addresses calldata array is iterated and pushed to the whitelist.
ownerMintedCount is compared against WLPerAddressLimit inside the whitelist branch of mint.
random local stores the modulo result used to index tokenMatrix.
maxIndex local = maxSupply - totalSupply() bounds the random range.
maxIndex is the divisor in the modulo of the keccak256 entropy.
value local holds the resolved token index written back to tokenMatrix.
loop counter i drives the per-mint loop and nextToken consumption.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only participates in mint bounds checks and loop control.
Parameter only feeds the mintCompliance modifier and _mintLoop call.
Parameter is only the destination of _mintLoop's _safeMint calls.
Parameter is only compared against whitelistedAddresses entries.
Parameter is only used to enumerate owned token ids.
Parameter is only used for existence check and metadata composition.
Parameter is only assigned to the paused state variable.
Parameter is only assigned to the cost state variable.
Parameter is only iterated to push into whitelistedAddresses.
Local only supports the WLPerAddressLimit check within mint.
Local only holds the index derived from the keccak entropy in nextToken.
Local is computed and consumed solely inside nextToken's tokenMatrix algorithm.
Local only records the resolved token index before returning value + startFrom.
Loop counter only controls the mint iteration that consumes nextToken and _safeMint.
